item.title: 20-year old ex-Navy recruit indicted for child sex crimes in Orange County
item.description: A 20-year-old ex-Navy recruit who had been indicted on multiple charges of child sexual abuse material has returned to Orange County to face them.

item.title: Former Northumberland, Lancaster deputy faces multiple sex offense charges
item.description: A former Lancaster and Northumberland County deputy is facing multiple sex offense charges in Northumberland, according to court records.

item.title: Chesterfield school bus involved in crash, police investigate
item.description: Police are investigating after a crash involving a Chesterfield school bus took place on Wednesday.

item.title: Day two of trial against Hopewell man accused of killing 8-year-old P’Aris Moore
item.description: Day two of a three-day trial against the man accused of killing 8-year-old P’Aris Moore continued Wednesday, Feb. 18. Both sides have rested their cases after the Commonwealth had 11 witnesses testify. The defense did not call any witnesses or provide any evidence.

item.title: Police: 55-year-old man reported missing out of Chesterfield after being robbed in Richmond
item.description: A 55-year-old man was reported missing out of Chesterfield County after police said he was robbed in Richmond in early February.

item.title: 'We don't know what the end game is': Hanover neighbors brace for data center vote
item.description: Neighbors in Hanover County are raising concerns about a proposed data center in Ashland, as the planning commission prepares to vote on the project at 6 p.m. Thursday at the Hanover County Administration Building.

item.title: RNC, NRCC file lawsuit to stop Virginia Democrats' redistricting proposal
item.description: The Republican National Committee (RNC), National Republican Congressional Committee (NRCC) and two GOP congressman have filed a lawsuit to stop redistricting plans proposed by Virginia Democrats.

item.title: Halfway through General Assembly session, Virginia Dems say they’re making life more affordable, Republicans disagree
item.description: At the halfway point of the 2026 General Assembly Session, Virginia Democrats say they’ve delivered on their affordability agenda.

item.title: Man found not guilty, yet sentenced to life asks Virginia's highest court to hear his bid for exoneration
item.description: The "Waverly Two," two men found not guilty of a Sussex County police officer's 1998 murder yet still sentenced to life in prison, stepped into Virginia's highest court on Wednesday to ask for another shot at getting one of them -- Terence Richardson -- a writ of actual innocence.

item.title: 'Can't sleep at night': Dozens of Superior Plus Propane customers left on empty, in the cold, for weeks
item.description: Dozens of Virginians say they waited more than a month for Superior Plus Propane to deliver much-needed fuel as they braced the winter cold without heat or answers.
